name: Mafia Online
storyline: Every night, the Mafia strikes. Every day, the town must find the killer. Bluff, deduce, and survive — using nothing but your intuition and live video communication.
summary:
Mafia Online Game by MafiaInLT is the first entertainment Mafia platform built for emotions, intuition, and the thrill of the bluff — playable by anyone, from first-timers to seasoned players.

Up to 10 players join a session and are secretly assigned roles: Mafia, Doctor, Sheriff, Lawyer, or Civilian. Every game plays out in real time — live video and audio for every participant, directly in the browser via WebRTC. Players vote, target, and interact by clicking on live video feeds. Faces, reactions, and hesitation are part of the game.

The platform is visually illustrated with crafted art and atmosphere designed to make each session feel like an event. The experience is built around entertainment, social connection, and the raw human dynamics of trust and deception.
